page0.text:
I hope I'm wrong, but...
Tohsaka won't be stingy about her gems, will she...?
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page0:1

page1.text: "Wait a sec. I just want to be sure here... You're not going to hold back, right? I know jewels are expensive, but your life is worth a lot more."
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page1:1

page2.text: "Hmph. Easy for you to say. You don't know the state of my finances. You'd probably lose your mind if you found out how much even one of these is worth."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page2:1

page3.text:
"Ha. I'd never lose my mind over money!
Fine. If you're so adamant, then I'll help with it. I just have to pay for half the value of the jewels you use, right?"
"Really? A man doesn't go back on his word?"
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page3:1

page4.text: "Nope. I have some savings, and I can earn money if I don't have enough. I'm having you use weapons you've accumulated over a lot of time, so I should help out too."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page4:1

page5.text:
...Okay, I might be making this offer out of pride.
I guess I want Tohsaka to see me in a positive light, no matter what.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page5:1

page6.text:
"Hey, what? That's a really, really weird look..."
"Well yes. I'm happy about it, and now I have something to look forward to.
By the way, Emiya. Aren't you curious how much one of these gems is worth?"
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page6:1

page7.text:
"Well, I suppose it's about a hundred thousand yen or something."
"No, no. That would get you a cheap throwaway gem at best."
"Maybe two hundred thousand yen?"
"Not going up by much there. Still wrong."
"Okay, how about two hundred fifty thousand yen?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page7:1

page8.text:
"You know, what you usually do when you're guessing prices is...you add zeroes.
Why are you not going up past the hundred thousands?"
"Gh... I kind of didn't want to say it, but three hundred thousand?"
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page8:1

page9.text:
"Again, I ask: Why do you refuse to go up another digit?"
"Ah...um...could it be a million yen...?"
The ground is falling away at my feet.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page9:1

page10.text:
"Close. Add another zero."
...And I am about to fall right into the bowels of hell itself.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page10:1

page11.text:
That's astronomical.
I've never heard a number so devastating before. If I were to turn that number into points of damage, I could beat any video game boss in a heartbeat.
"What's wrong? You look pale, Emiya."
"Uh...no, I'm fine. I can calculate fine."
Oh, I can calculate all right. And it's hurting more than math ever should.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page11:1

page12.text:
"Oh really? Then I'll ask you one more time: I can use my gems, right? I won't hold back. It'll be spectacular. Are you good with that?"
...Ugh.
I fight back the desire to tell Tohsaka to use them sparingly.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page12:1

page13.text:
"Tohsaka...I'm going to be in your debt."
I try to sound as brave as I can.
"Of course. I won't charge you interest, so you can spend all your life paying me back."
Tohsaka...clearly isn't joking.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-08:page13:1
